description: Writes a Playwright test file (TypeScript) with one test per sandbox scenario of a gateway: card, expiry, CVV, and the extra fields the gateway needs (e.g. NetPay customer email, Mercado Pago or Adyen cardholder name), taken from official docs. Selectors in fillCheckout/expectOutcome are a starting point the user must map to their checkout. Returns the file contents; the server writes nothing to disk.

checkoutUrl.description: http(s) URL of the checkout in test mode.

lang.description: Language for descriptions, notes and hints. Default "en".

name: generate_checkout_tests
title: Generate checkout tests
